scope: Proteomics of EVs from cells activated with TNF‐α alone or in the presence of Iloprost revealed a distinct composition

EVs derived from monocytes treated with TNFα in presence or absence of Iloprost were pelleted at 20,000xg for 30 min, resuspended in 20 μl ice cold RIPA buffer containing protease inhibitor (Sigma Aldrich).
50 μg of proteins were used for trypsin digestion. Mass spectrometry analysis of the proteins obtained from two technical replicates of EVs was performed
